subject: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) :    At least one element of obsCovs has incorrect number of dimensions.

messages.author: 6fad4d9e78cafeb4
messages.subject: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) :    At least one element of obsCovs has incorrect number of dimensions.
parts:
Hi everyone,
I am having some problems with the multi-species occupancy model, more specifically in unmarkedFrameOccuMulti function with the error: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
At least one element of obsCovs has incorrect number of dimensions.

The data is correct, with the same number of rows in the occCovs and obsCovs, so I don't understand what is wrong. I need some help, and I would appreciate it with someone could send me some.

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : At least one element of obsCovs has incorrect number of dimensions.
parts:
The siteCovs should be a data frame with dimensions N x P where N is the number of sites and P is the number of site-level covariates.

The obsCovs should either be (1) a data frame with dimensions N*J x P2 where N is the number of sites, J is the number of occasions, and P2 is the number of obs-level covariates; or (2) a named list of matrices each with dimensions NxJ, one matrix per observation covariate.

It sounds like you want to use a site-level covariate (i.e., one measurement per site) as an observation-level covariate. If that's the case, just include it siteCovs. You can still use it in detection formulas.

Ken
